Changes made to `0.html`:

- Gave the page a real `<title>` ("Circle" instead of the opaque ID)
- Added a dark background for contrast and `box-sizing: border-box`
- Made the SVG responsive (`min(400px, 80vw)`) so it scales on small screens

- Slightly reduced the radius (196 vs 200) so the stroke/edge doesn't clip at the viewBox boundary
